conf.description: Forcepoint DLP Incident Risk Ranking case, syslog/CEF, per recommendations.direct.cribl. Same transport and CEF header/extension parse as the incident pipeline; branches out of the shared 'DLP Syslog' Name header on the presence of riskScore (see dm_forcepoint_dlp_incident_syslog_cef for the sibling incident branch). caseDateAndTime uses an abbreviated month with a trailing period and a 12-hour clock, which defeats strict date processors, so the period is stripped before Date.parse. eventIDs and caseSummary are vendor-capped lists; an explicit truncation flag is set when the vendor's ellipsis marks a capped list.

functions.description: Split the 7 pipe-delimited CEF header fields from the extension string.

Extract every CEF extension key=value pair. Non-greedy value + lookahead on the next key= (or end of string) so multi-word values like msg are not cut at the first space, which a naive kv splitter would do.
Keep only case records: CEF Name=DLP Syslog carrying a riskScore (plain incidents share this Name header but never carry riskScore).
Batch-rename every status:mapped field to its ECS target.
Relocate the case-analytics fields to forcepoint.dlp.case.*; split the semicolon/comma-separated lists; flag the vendor's 20-id/1024-char eventIDs cap when its ellipsis is present.
Fallback event time from the syslog header.
Set _time from caseDateAndTime after stripping the abbreviated month's trailing period (assumed UTC - see README); tag event.dataset.
